aboutBatam.heading: About Batam
paragraphs: Batam City is one of the islands in the Riau Islands Province, which is located between the Malacca Strait and Singapore which as a whole form the Batam region.
Batam City is a tropical area, with average temperatures ranging from 24 to 35 degrees Celsius (77 to 95 degrees Fahrenheit).
The humidity in this region ranges from 73% to 96%. In general, the rainy season starts from November to April and the dry season from May to October.
The average annual rainfall is around 2600 mm.

cultureLanguage.heading: Culture & Language
paragraphs: The population of Batam City consists of diverse cultures and ethnicities, and Malay Culture is the dominant culture in the city of Batam.

Despite the diversity of cultures and languages, Indonesian as the national language is still used, and English is taught in schools and is more commonly used among business and multinational companies.

religion.heading: Religion
paragraphs: The six major religions that are most widely practiced in Indonesia are Islam, Christianity (Protestantism) and Catholicism, Hinduism, Buddhism, and Confucianism.
However, this does not mean that other religions and beliefs cannot grow and develop in Indonesia.
The government is even obliged to encourage and support the development of these religions.
Islam is the majority religion in Batam City. As a symbol of the religious diversity of Batam society, the government built the Batam Grand Mosque located in the city center near the public square.
Christianity and Catholicism are also practiced by the people of Batam, especially those from the Batak and Flores ethnic groups.
Buddhism is the religion most widely practiced by Chinese Indonesians.
Batam City has a monastery which is the largest monastery in Southeast Asia, namely Vihara Duta Maitreya.

sections.heading: UIB Tuition Fee Summary
paragraphs: The tuition fees for UIB students consist of:
items: New student fees. These fees are paid only once during re-registration. The new student fees consist of building fees (SPP) and PPL fees.
Active student fees (per semester fees). These fees are paid every semester as tuition fees. The semester fees consist of BPP Pokok, credit fees, and laboratory fees (if applicable).

rows:

2. Administration Fee

B. Semester Fees

2. Credit Fees (21 Credits × Rp 175.000,-)
3. Laboratory Fees

paragraphs: The building fee or SPP fee varies depending on the registration wave selected.
In addition to the registration wave, the building fee (SPP) is also influenced by the USM ranking.
The USM ranking is a classification based on the entrance examination results.

sections.heading: Transfer Student Registration Requirements
sections.description: The following are the registration requirements as a transfer student at Universitas Internasional Batam:

items.text: Submit academic transcripts from previous education.

emailInfo.label: Documents should be sent via email:

items.text: The university will conduct transcript equalization to the selected study program;
The equalization form signed by Vice Rector I will be sent to the applicant via email, then the applicant may continue the registration process and UIB Entrance Examination.

sections.heading: Registration Requirements for Overseas Graduates (High School or Diploma)
paragraphs: Diploma and Bachelor Degree (S1) certificates originating from overseas must be equalized at KEMENRISTEKDIKTI Jakarta.
Meanwhile, high school certificates must be equalized at the Ministry of Education and Culture Jakarta.
Applicants may also attach Paket C certificates and SKHU that have already been issued.
Documents should be sent via email: humas@uib.ac.id

callout.heading: Note:
callout.description: The equalization process is carried out online through the official website of the related institution.

paragraphs: Prospective new students who come from outside the Batam area will be facilitated with pick-up, transportation, and preparation for accommodation in Batam City.
The student pick-up service is carried out when prospective students arrive at the airport or port and are transported to the UIB campus.

Afterward, students will also be assisted with transportation for shopping accommodation necessities and going to their residence, either at the UIB dormitory or nearby boarding houses around the UIB campus.
This student assistance service is available for all prospective UIB students who are interested or willing to use the service.
Students will also continue to be accompanied by Public Relations staff for their comfort and safety.

contact.heading: Contact
contact.description: For prospective students from outside Batam who would like to receive this service, please contact humas@uib.ac.id.

residence.heading: Nearest Residence Information for Universitas Internasional Batam Students

dormitoryInfo.heading: UIB Dormitory Information
paragraphs: The Universitas Internasional Batam Dormitory has been operating since 2019 with one main building and a residential capacity of 96 female students and 104 male students.
The dormitory is designed to provide a safe, comfortable, and supportive living environment for students during their academic journey at UIB.
Prospective students who are interested in staying at the UIB dormitory may contact the UIB Public Relations WhatsApp number at 0812-7526-2369.

items.title: Dormitory Room
items.description: The room facilities include bunk beds, study desks, chairs, and storage cabinets to support student comfort.

items.title: Dormitory Environment
items.description: The dormitory area has a clean and organized environment that supports student activities and interactions while living in Batam.

entranceExam.heading: Entrance Examination for New Undergraduate Students
paragraphs: Every prospective applicant for the Scholarship and Regular Admission pathways is required to take the Entrance Examination held by Universitas Internasional Batam.
The stages, requirements, and procedures for the Entrance Examination are as follows:

examStages.heading: Entrance Examination Stages
examStages.description: The Universitas Internasional Batam Entrance Examination consists of:

items.title: Computer Based Test or Academic Potential Test (Mathematics, Indonesian, and English).
Interview or Interview Test with Universitas Internasional Batam lecturers.
items.description: The interview is conducted within 5 – 10 minutes.

offlineConditions.heading: Conditions for Taking the Offline Entrance Examination

items.text: Wear a white shirt, black pants (non-jeans material), and shoes;
Bring a personal identity card such as ID Card/Student Card/Passport/Driver's License.
The Entrance Examination results will be announced 2 days after the examination and can be viewed on the official website and social media of Universitas Internasional Batam.

onlineConditions.heading: Conditions for Taking the Online Entrance Examination

items.text: Wear appropriate and polite clothing;
Follow the procedures for conducting the online examination (system trial, online interview, and online written test).
items.description: The procedure guide will be provided by the committee one day before the online examination.

items.text: The Entrance Examination results will be announced 2 days after the examination and can be viewed on the official website and social media of Universitas Internasional Batam.
